title: Find Indices With Index and Value Difference I
sourceKind: web-search-snippets (official page not fetchable; snippets cite leetcode.com and mirrors)
summary: Given 0-indexed nums, indexDifference and valueDifference, return a pair [i, j] with |i - j| >= indexDifference and |nums[i] - nums[j]| >= valueDifference, or [-1, -1]. Any valid pair is accepted.
officialConstraints: 1 <= n <= 100; 0 <= nums[i] <= 50; 0 <= indexDifference <= 100; 0 <= valueDifference <= 50 (as reported by search snippets; not confirmed on the official page).
visualizationNotes: Brute force over ordered pairs; the visual caps nums at 100 values. Examples come from search snippets, not a fetched statement, so they are not marked as verified.
